body.name: G_H^{\mathrm{ord}}
body.type: maximal temporal-order acyclic directed mixed graph
body.def: \(G_H^{\mathrm{ord}}\) contains every directed arrow \(a\to v\) with \(a\prec_H v\) and every bidirected pair of distinct vertices in \(\mathcal W_H\).
body.role: Single maximal graph representing the complete order-only comparator.
